import numpy as np

# Fiscal year sums (in millions USD)
x = np.array([1990, 1991, 1992, 1993])
y = np.array([35912852, 40757150, 45666452, 50222460])

# Fit linear regression: y = a*x + b
A = np.vstack([x, np.ones(len(x))]).T
a, b = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y, rcond=None)[0]

print(f"Linear regression: y = {a:.2f}*x + {b:.2f}")
print(f"Slope (a): {a:.2f}")
print(f"Intercept (b): {b:.2f}")

# Predict for FY1995
fy1995_sum = a * 1995 + b
fy1995_average = fy1995_sum / 12

print(f"\nPrediction for FY1995:")
print(f"  Sum of monthly totals: {fy1995_sum:.2f} million USD")
print(f"  Average monthly outstanding: {fy1995_average:.2f} million USD")
print(f"  Rounded: {round(fy1995_average)}")
EOF
